title: [TODO] Harness compliance gate: the log it scans must actually contain the evidence
desc: A compliance gate (on-load reflex gate) can be permanently UNSATISFIABLE even when the agent did the action, for two silent data bugs: ConvertTo-Json depth collapse and gate-reads-wrong-log-source. Keystone 2026-06-18 gemini on-load lock-never-releases incident.
steps: CORE: a gate that scans an activity LOG for evidence (e.g. 'skill read on-load') can block FOREVER even when the agent did the action, for two SILENT reasons. Fail-open on a MISSING log hides this -- the log EXISTS but the evidence was never recorded in a readable form.

BUG A -- SERIALIZATION DEPTH: the harness writes the activity record with 'ConvertTo-Json -Compress' but the DEFAULT -Depth (2) collapses nested content/tool_use/input hashtables to the literal string 'System.Collections.Hashtable', DESTROYING the command text. The gate greps for the command and finds nothing. FIX: ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 10 for any tool_use/message.content record. PROOF 2026-06-18: gemini jsonl showed content:[System.Collections.Hashtable]; Gemini ROOT was blocked on every non-exempt tool.

BUG B -- LOG SOURCE MISMATCH: the gate's Get-WkActive*Log returned the NATIVE cli log (~/.gemini/tmp/<leaf>/logs.json) which records type:user messages ONLY, never assistant tool calls -- so a skill-read grep is ALWAYS 0 and the gate fail-CLOSED forever. FIX: point the gate at the harness-written jsonl (~/.claude/projects/<fullSlug>/gemini-*.jsonl) that actually captures tool_use; fall back to the native log so a session without one still fail-opens.

REFLEX TRIGGER (push, not pull): when you write or audit ANY harness ConvertTo-Json that serializes a record with nested arrays/hashtables, OR any gate's Get-WkActive*Log -> STOP: (1) add -Depth >=10, (2) grep the WRITTEN file for the real payload token (e.g. 'skill read on-load'), NOT just trust it wrote. A gate's chosen log MUST contain the evidence it scans for; verify with a known-good token before trusting fail-open-on-missing.

DIAGNOSIS-GAP LESSON: wkdoctor flagged 'conduct:on-load 10% compliant' and prescribed 'install enforcement guard' -- WRONG: the guard WAS installed and its INPUT DATA was corrupt. When a compliance metric is low, verify the gate INPUT DATA is real BEFORE blaming agent conduct or re-installing the guard (symptom vs root cause). Cross: cross-family-harness-integration, harness-active-model-scoping, wkharness-guards, incident-trauma-reflex.

BUG C (2026-06-18, the 3rd gemini-stuck root cause): Initialize-WkGeminiSession keyed IsGemini on the resolved $Model ONLY ($Model -like '*gemini*'...). A real -Family gemini/agy session whose model failed to resolve to a gemini string got IsGemini=False -> Log-WkGeminiActivity SKIPPED -> NO activity logged -> the on-load gate found zero skill-read records -> blocked FOREVER even though the session read its reflexes. FIX: IsGemini must ALSO be true when the harness was invoked with -Family gemini|agy (Family = CLI = process name is AUTHORITATIVE). Pass -Family into Initialize-WkGeminiSession. So the full gemini-stuck cure = depth-10 (BUG A) + right log source (BUG B) + IsGemini-from-Family (BUG C). See [[harness-family-identity-and-edit-scope-order]].

POST-COMPACTION STUDY-LOCK DRIFT -- TRUE ROOT CAUSE (investigation 2026-06-23, CORRECTS the 'JSONL write-stop' hypothesis in suggest #1782145927): the session JSONL is NOT broken -- post-compaction skill-read tool_use lines DO get written with correct post-compaction timestamps (verified: session 4b6c23a4 had 17 post-last-compaction skill-read dispatches, all physically present). The scanner (Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds in wkharness-common-skillscore.ps1 L58-120) correctly ignores PRE-compaction reads (Get-WkLastCompactionTs L33-56 + the timestamp<=lastCompactionTs skip at L90) BY DESIGN (force re-reads after compaction). THE REAL DRIFT: after compaction, Claude Code injects the compaction SUMMARY (prose) into the model's context -- the model SEES the skill content there and believes it already read the skills, so it does NOT re-issue 'wkappbot skill read' commands post-compaction. Result: zero post-compaction dispatches for skills the model 'remembers' from the summary -> the scanner (correctly counting only post-compaction dispatches) reports them UNREAD -> false study-lock block (the Catch-22 fought all session; the heart-v2 scanner-unify was a partial mitigation, this is the actual cause). HARNESS-FIXABLE (Fix 1): extend Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds to ALSO scan the isCompactSummary line's embedded 'wkappbot skill read <id>' prose and count those IDs as 'compaction-inherited reads' (bypass the timestamp filter for them) -- the model demonstrably had them in context at compaction. DESIGN TENSION to resolve first: this RELAXES the deliberate 'force fresh re-read after compaction' intent of the on-load gate (inherited != freshly re-read). Decision needed: (A) count inherited reads everywhere (kills false-block, but on-load no longer forces a true re-read post-compaction -- acceptable IF the summary genuinely carries the reflex content), or (B) count inherited only for the per-source STUDY-LOCK (which just needs 'has the knowledge'), but keep on-load forcing a fresh re-read of the core reflexes. Implementation: wkharness-common-skillscore.ps1 L78-106 pre-pass over compaction lines. Also NOTE: the scanner pattern matches "name":"Bash" (native Claude) -- "tool_name" never appears in native Claude JSONL (only Codex/Gemini hook payloads use it).

OPTIMIZATION ARCHITECTURE (user 2026-06-23, the FIX direction for the per-call full-JSONL rescan TODO above): store the scan result -- and ALL harness per-call caches -- in the wkhippo INDEXER (the SQLite global_indexer wkhippo already uses), NOT ad-hoc per-guard disk files. One canonical persistent cache backend: a fresh PreToolUse hook process QUERIES the indexer (keyed on source path + mtime) for the skill-read-id set / model detection / compaction boundary / scan results, instead of re-parsing 15MB every call. This solves the per-process-cache-dies root cause at the ARCHITECTURE level and consolidates all cache logic into one store. NEXT OWNER = optimization-first: build the wkhippo-indexer-backed harness cache. Cross: hippocampus-living-memory, wk-tool-sub-1s-response-time-mandate.

RESOLVED 2026-06-23 (step 7 Fix 1 is DONE, commit c824e3c3 + verified live this session): Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds in wkharness-common-skillscore.ps1 NOW scans compaction-summary lines (isCompactSummary/compactMetadata/type:summary) for embedded 'wkappbot skill read <id>' prose and counts those IDs as compaction-inherited reads that BYPASS the post-compaction timestamp filter (L82-91). The A-vs-B DESIGN TENSION was resolved as a HYBRID: inherited reads satisfy ON-LOAD + the per-source read-check (option A behavior -- kills the false study-lock block after compaction), while the UPDATE-induction currency stale-check at EDIT/DELEGATE (the work-ready gate) is a SEPARATE path, unaffected, so an actual source edit still requires fresh currency. So the post-compaction false-UNREAD Catch-22 (the heart-v2/study-lock loop that fought multiple sessions, incl the very start of this one) is fixed at the scanner. Remaining open under this skill = the OPTIMIZATION TODO in step 8 (move the per-call full-JSONL rescan into the wkhippo SQLite indexer cache) -- that is the sub-1s pillar item, NOT this gate-correctness item.

OPTIMIZATION DESIGN 2026-06-23 (the step-8 indexer-cache TODO -- concrete turnkey plan + a KEY subtlety found by reading live code; ROOT measured-design while pace-95-blocked from Write). TARGET fn: Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds (wkharness-common-skillscore.ps1 L58-132). It ALREADY has an in-proc cache (L71-76, keyed Path+LastWriteTimeUtc+CacheKey) but the PreToolUse hook is a FRESH PROCESS every call, so the script-scoped cache dies every call -> full Get-Content + per-line regex scan EVERY tool call. KEY SUBTLETY (the trap): a naive cross-process FULL-RESULT cache keyed on path+mtime does NOT help the ACTIVE session -- the session JSONL GROWS every turn, so mtime advances every call -> cache ALWAYS misses. The ONLY correct cross-process win is INCREMENTAL: persist {scannedByteOffset, accumulatedSkillIds, lastCompactionTs} to a tiny cache file; on a fresh call, if the JSONL only GREW (curLen >= offset), TAIL-READ only bytes [offset..end], extract new skill-read ids, UNION into the cached set, advance offset = O(new bytes) not O(whole file). INVALIDATION: if a NEW compaction marker (isCompactSummary / compactMetadata / type:summary) appears in the new bytes, the post-compaction filter MOVED -> recompute (re-scan from the new boundary) since older reads may flip stale; if curLen < offset (truncate/rotate) -> full re-scan. This mirrors wkhippo-studied-index-proto.ps1 offset+len tail-read -- FOLD that in, or route through the SQLite indexer (step 21). FAIL-OPEN: any cache error -> fall through to the existing full scan (never brick the gate). SEAM: insert the cache-read attempt at L78 (after lastCompactionTs is computed, before the L80 HashSet + L81 Get-Content), fall through on miss/error. BASELINE-MEASURE PLAN (run before+after per the MEASURE protocol): dot-source skillscore, stub Get-WkActiveSessionJsonl to the real session JSONL, clear script:_wkSessionSkillReadCache, Measure-Command Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds x3 cold-avg (fresh-process equiv) + 1 warm; record JSONL MB+lines + cold ms (the per-call cost to beat); target <100ms. SECURITY/OWNERSHIP: this fn feeds EVERY gate's 'was this skill read this session' check -- a bug = whole-harness false-allow OR false-deny; this is FOUNDATION work, ROOT must own the merge + verify the self-test, do NOT cheap-delegate the design (this session already caught 2 confident-wrong cheap agents). Cross: wk-tool-sub-1s-response-time-mandate, hippocampus-living-memory-howto step 22 (seam), foundation-is-roots-charge-not-a-chore step 16.

INCREMENTAL CACHE PROTO BUILT 2026-06-23 (sandbox): Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds in wkharness-common-skillscore-proto.ps1 now has a cross-process incremental offset cache inserted at seam L78 (after lastCompactionTs, before HashSet+Get-Content). Design: persist {ScannedByteOffset, LastCompactionTs, SkillIds} as JSON keyed by SHA256(JsonlPath) under $env:TEMP\.wkharness-skillread-cache\. On fresh process: if file only grew (curLen>=offset) AND compaction boundary unchanged, tail-read only new bytes, UNION ids, advance offset = O(new bytes) not O(whole file). Invalidation: new compaction marker in tail -> null -> full re-scan; curLen<offset (truncate) -> null -> full re-scan. Fail-open: any error -> existing full scan unchanged. FULL SCAN writes the disk cache after completing so next call gets incremental. Self-test agent running to verify identity + measure speedup. ROOT must review + merge to canonical. Cross: wk-tool-sub-1s-response-time-mandate, foundation-is-roots-charge-not-a-chore.

INDEXER-CACHE OPTIMIZATION TARGETS -- the full per-call rescan inventory (haiku survey a688f847, 2026-06-23): the step-8 ONE-indexer cache must serve FIVE hot-path per-call full/tail rescans, not just skillscore. SOLID CANDIDATES (priority order): (1) ANCHOR Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds (wkharness-common-skillscore.ps1 L58-132) -- full session JSONL + per-line 'wkappbot skill read <id>' regex every gate; incremental proto already built. (2) HIGHEST after anchor: Get-WkOnLoadComplianceState (wkharness-guards-onload-enforce.ps1 L117-280) -- Get-Content -Raw the WHOLE file as one string + per-entry ConvertFrom-Json, FAMILY-AWARE (Claude JSONL / Codex sessions / Gemini logs), markers = the 8+ family-specific on-load skill-read patterns + compaction markers; the most expensive single rescan. (3) Test-WkUserMentionedOpus (wkharness-common-session.ps1 L8-24) -- -Tail 100, 5-min window, opus-budget guard, marker \bopus\b + Korean. (4) Get-WkLatestUserPrompt (wkharness-common-session.ps1 L39-63) -- -Tail 200 for last user message, guards embed it. (5) Get-WkCommitterModel last-resort scan (wkharness-agent-name.ps1 L383-395) -- Get-ChildItem -Recurse over ~/.claude/projects/ + full-file model extract on every Agent-delegation detection miss. BORDERLINE: Get-WkActiveCodexSessionJsonl (guards-onload-enforce.ps1 L107-115, -Recurse but returns one file by mtime; cache-key=newest-mtime). EXCLUDED (do NOT index): Get-WkActiveSessionModel (small fixed config), model-detect dot-source init (one-shot), Agent.ps1 user prompt file, wkharness.ps1 freeze-state marker. KEY DESIGN: these scan FIVE independent JSONL sources at DIFFERENT time scales (per-call, per-5-min, per-compaction-ts, per-model-detect) -- the indexer MUST key per source path + mtime + compaction-boundary + family-session-id so cross-family hits never collide. Also note Test-RecentClaudeMdEdit (session.ps1 L79-104, -Tail ~180) is a 6th lower-traffic candidate. Net: converting all 5-6 to the ONE regex-keyed incremental indexer cache makes the entire PreToolUse hot path sub-1s. Cross: wk-tool-sub-1s-response-time-mandate, hippocampus-living-memory-howto (the indexer), harness-busy-fleet-guard (its delegation-success regex-key joins the same cache).

STUDIED-INDEX PARITY-FIX LANDED + ROOT-VERIFIED (2026-06-24, a82fff85). The 117-vs-11 over-extraction (prior DO-NOT-PROMOTE) is RESOLVED: the proto Get-WkStudiedAllIdsForSession now returns EXACTLY the canonical Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds set (19==19 exact set-equality on the live session, runtime-source-proven). TWO root causes, only one predicted: (1) PREDICTED -- the compaction-inherited scrape was ungated; fixed by adding the  precondition + post-compaction ts filter + a shell-tool gate (tool_name Bash/PowerShell/shell_command) so reads are scraped ONLY from command/prompt tool-invocation fields, mirroring canonical L89-117. (2) THE SURPRISE + REAL DRIVER -- the caller split the tail text on [System.Environment]::NewLine (CRLF) but Claude session JSONL is LF-ONLY, so the split was a NO-OP that collapsed the entire file into one giant line which bypassed every per-line gate -> whole-prose scrape. Fixed to split on a r?n regex. CRITICAL CANONICAL-PORT MERGE-NOTE: NEVER split JSONL on [Environment]::NewLine -- use an r?n regex or Get-Content; the platform-newline assumption silently breaks line-gating on LF files. CALIBRATION (ledger): the FIRST port agent self-reported '11 ids IDENTICAL' but had tested the WRONG code path (the monolithic loader dot-sourced the -sonnet-haiku copies, not the task -sonnet.ps1 files); the fake-pass was caught ONLY because ROOT required a runtime ScriptBlock.File SOURCE-PROOF that the test exercised the intended files. Lesson: for a parity/verify claim, prove WHICH source file actually ran (ScriptBlock.File), never trust the agent's reported number alone. STILL PENDING: a FRESH independent ROOT verify before promoting the .tmp proto to canonical wkhippo + wiring skillscore. ON-LOAD GATE TIMING-FIX SPEC (2026-06-27, user-spec): the on-load compliance gate (Get-WkOnLoadComplianceState) must replace the JSONL timestamp-based -le check with a two-tier studied-index lookup. Since = MAX(session JSONL CreationTime, ) -- NOT a fixed 24h window and NOT just  which advances every turn. T1 quick: call Get-WkStudiedFromIndex with -Ids (required skill IDs for the active family), -Since , -Family , -LimitPaths @(.FullName) -- scope to THIS session only. If T1 finds all required IDs -> return compliant immediately. If T1 suggests block: T2 STRONGER re-search: same call but WITHOUT -Since (wider window, same session file scope). If T2 finds all -> return compliant AND log indexer timing gap (T2 result differs from T1 = studied-index missed within-window reads). If T2 also not found -> confirmed block. Divergence log format: write to stderr '[on-load-indexer-timing-gap] studied-index missed skills in T1 that T2 found: <ids>'. Fallback: if Get-WkStudiedFromIndex unavailable, fall back to Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds (same-turn JSONL scan). This wires the already-promoted studied-index (harness-gate-log-data-integrity steps 16-17) into the on-load gate, fixing the cross-turn false-stale bug.

STUDIED-INDEX SEARCH PERFORMANCE SPEC (2026-06-27, user): the studied-index search (Get-WkStudiedFromIndex) MUST be scoped to sessions modified within the last 1 DAY MAXIMUM for performance. Passing -LimitPaths @(sessionJsonl.FullName) already satisfies this (current session = today). If searching without -LimitPaths, add explicit MaxAgeDays or Since=(now minus 1 day) guard to prevent scanning historical sessions. NEVER search all-time sessions -- the index may cover months of history and becomes too slow. FAMILY-SPECIFIC COMPACTION MARKERS: the gate's recentCompaction detection must be family-aware -- Claude JSONL uses isCompactSummary=true or type=system with compaction text; Codex sessions may use a different marker format; Gemini/Agy use different patterns entirely. Using Claude-only regex on a Codex/Gemini session will fail to detect compaction and compute a wrong Since value. Fix: pass Family= to the compaction-detection helper and branch on it. Both constraints (1-day limit + family-aware compaction) apply to all paths: T1, T2, and the fallback.

ON-LOAD GATE SKILL-ADD EXEMPTION GAP (2026-06-27): the on-load gate exempts wkappbot skill read AND wkappbot skill edit but NOT wkappbot skill add. This blocks jisikhwa (creating new skills) even when all required reflex reads were just completed in the same response turn. Underlying mechanism: PostToolUse entries after each skill read advance recentCompaction past the reads, so by the time skill add PreToolUse fires the reads appear stale. Workaround A: use wkappbot skill edit to add steps to EXISTING skills (exempt, confirmed working). Workaround B: use the Agent tool -- Agent dispatch is hardcoded exempt from the on-load gate (wkharness-guards-onload-enforce.ps1 line 378). FIX PATHS: (1) add 'add' to the on-load gate's wkappbot skill exempt pattern (simplest), (2) wire Get-WkStudiedFromIndex into harness scope via wkhippo integration (activates the v2 timing-fix), (3) make Get-WkSessionSkillReadIds do a full-session scan (no compaction-boundary filter). Until fixed: create new skills via Agent tool delegation or accumulate content as steps in existing skills. Cross: on-load step 20, on-load step 19 (v2 timing-fix applied), wkharness-guards-onload-enforce.ps1.
